SKYSHIFT interface adaptations

Vengeance UI / Spotlight Navbar
Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Ashutoshx7. MIT License (Vengeance-LICENSE.txt).
Native adaptation in orbital-interactions.js and orbital-design.css:
pointer-following spotlight, active-link ambience, keyboard focus equivalent.
React state and Motion springs replaced with native events and CSS.
Source: https://github.com/Ashutoshx7/VengeanceUI

Skiper UI / Skiper 40 CssLink / Link000 and Link001
Author: @gurvinder-singh02 / gxuri, https://gxuri.me
Website: https://skiper-ui.com/v1/preview/skiper40
Source registry: https://skiper-ui.com/r/skiper40.json
Upstream source's license and usage notice:
- Free to use and modify in both personal and commercial projects.
- Attribution to Skiper UI is required when using the free version.
- No attribution required with Skiper UI Pro.
Source comments identify the work as inspired by https://cursor.com/?from=home,
an independent recreation, not associated with cursor.com.
Adapted to native CSS in orbital-design.css: direction-aware underline and
arrow transition, keyboard focus state and reduced-motion behavior.
Visible Skiper UI attribution is retained in the website footer; source and
license records are linked through Sources & acknowledgments.
Only the explicitly free Skiper40 was retrieved. No Pro components used.

dqnamo / The Kitchen
https://www.dqnamo.com/kitchen
https://www.dqnamo.com/experiments/tactile-button
https://www.dqnamo.com/experiments/iridescent-foil
Design inspiration only. No explicit code reuse license was identified on the
inspected pages. No Kitchen source, logo, illustration, or CSS was copied.
SKYSHIFT's compressible main action and restrained surface treatments are
original implementations informed by these public interaction studies.

All adaptations run locally. No external runtime scripts, analytics, React,
Next.js, Motion, or remote fonts were added. Scientific data are unaffected.
